item.title: BREAKING: Nigeria’s Ex-Acting Accountant-General Nwabuoku Sentenced To 72 Years For N868Million Fraud
item.description: BREAKING: Nigeria’s Ex-Acting Accountant-General Nwabuoku Sentenced To 72 Years For N868Million Fraud Justice James Omotosho delivered the judgment on Monday, March 23, 2026, after finding Nwabuoku guilty on multiple counts of money laundering in a case prosecuted by the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) involving N868,465,000.

item.title: Nigerian Military Blocks Access To Officers Detained Indefinitely For Alleged Coup As Family Members Die In Depression
item.description: Nigerian Military Blocks Access To Officers Detained Indefinitely For Alleged Coup As Family Members Die In Depression The human toll of the prolonged detention has been devastating, with families of the affected officers reportedly dying from grief and emotional trauma.

item.title: BREAKING: IGP Disu Orders Fresh Posting Of Police Commissioners Nationwide, Fatai Replaces Jimoh As Lagos CP
item.description: BREAKING: IGP Disu Orders Fresh Posting Of Police Commissioners Nationwide, Fatai Replaces Jimoh As Lagos CP Tijani Olaiwola Fatai has been posted to Lagos State Command, Morkwap S. Dongshal to Taraba State, and Ahmed Mohammed Bello to Zamfara State Command.

item.title: BREAKING: Residents Flee Omugo Community Kwara After Terrorists Attacked ECWA Church As Military, Police Are Visibly Absent
item.description: BREAKING: Residents Flee Omugo Community Kwara After Terrorists Attacked ECWA Church As Military, Police Are Visibly Absent A visit to the community by SaharaReporters revealed a ghost-town atmosphere, with deserted streets, locked homes and residents hurriedly leaving the area for safer locations.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Two Family Members Kidnapped During ECWA Church Service In Kwara Community, Family Appeals For Help
item.description: EXCLUSIVE: Two Family Members Kidnapped During ECWA Church Service In Kwara Community, Family Appeals For Help During the incident, which took place at an ECWA church service on Sunday, suspected bandits reportedly abducted several members and assaulted a 90-year-old woman, leaving her injured.
